# Fine-tuning (deep learning)

- 主题标签: llm
- 抓取时间(UTC): 2026-05-04T15:12:45.764778+00:00
- 来源: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fine-tuning_(deep_learning)

## 摘要
Fine-tuning is the process of adapting a model trained for one task to perform a different, usually more specific, task. It is considered a form of transfer learning, as it reuses knowledge learned from the original training objective.
